mechanism: Canvas dial gauge with needle maps built-in iRSI(14) onto 0–100 arc with fixed color pie zones (0–30, 30–70, 70–100); separate-window line plot mirrors the same RSI. No new sensing transform beyond stock RSI visualization.
data_needed: iRSI handle on chart symbol/period; canvas redraw on new bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 _Symbol/_Period; RSI period 14 on close.
why_new_for_mis: After full read this part is an MQL5 canvas/UI tutorial for displaying classic RSI; no novel regime/vol/liquidity/sequence sensor beyond stock oscillator chrome.
quote: we aim to build a modular framework that separates graphical layers for the scale and needle, allowing independent transparency and updates for efficiency.

mechanism: Sensitive WaveTrend oscillator emits bull/bear crosses; optional slower WaveTrend trend filter; on confirmed cross open a price box (high/low, optionally ± avg_candle_size×multiplier); signal fires only when close breaks box top (buy) or bottom (sell), optionally requiring breakout direction to match box dir.
data_needed: OHLC; dual WaveTrend buffers (signal + trend); avg candle body size; BoxInfo array of active ranges.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 _Symbol/_Period (Smart WaveTrend Crossover chart window).
why_new_for_mis: Regime-filtered momentum cross gated by range-break confirmation—MIS change sensor that waits for price to leave the crossover bar’s envelope rather than firing on oscillator alone.
quote: a crossover upward on the signal oscillator, optionally confirmed by an uptrend on the slower oscillator, initiates a box around the bar's range; upon an upward breakout from the box, a buy signal triggers

mechanism: Fog gradient drawn from hl2 toward edge_price = hl2 ± 6×(avg_candle_size×offset_mult) with direction/color from trend_hist sign; transparency ramps with distance from hl2 so denser fog marks stronger trend context.
data_needed: High/low/close; trend_hist buffer; rolling avg |close−open| (50 bars); canvas pixel columns.
why_new_for_mis: Trend-histogram polarity rendered as volatility-scaled spatial fog—MIS visual/structural regime cue coupling momentum sign with local candle-body scale.
quote: Fog gradients overlay the chart to visually represent trend strength with fading transparency, helping us gauge market context at a glance

mechanism: Rolling mean of |close−open| (and separately high−low over tp_sl_length) scales box extensions and multi-level TP/SL via Candle_Multiplier or Percentage modes (TP1/2/3 and SL multipliers or %).
data_needed: OHLC over 50 / tp_sl_length bars; user TP/SL mode and multipliers.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit short-horizon candle-body/range average as a live volatility scale for structure boxes and risk levels—MIS local vol sensor tied to momentum events.
quote: calculating take-profit and stop-loss levels based on average candle sizes or percentage moves

mechanism: Over lookback DynamicBoundaryLength, take min/max of computed RSI; set top = low + TopBoundaryPercent×range/100, bottom = low + BottomBoundaryPercent×range/100, center = mid-range; static mode uses fixed percents when length≤1.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any _Symbol; AnalysisTimeframe (≥ chart period) with optional MTF.
why_new_for_mis: OB/OS thresholds that self-fit recent RSI extremes instead of fixed 70/30—MIS adaptive momentum-regime bands for changing volatility of the oscillator itself.
quote: Dynamic boundaries will adapt overbought and oversold levels based on recent RSI extremes over a specified length, while static ones will use fixed percentages

mechanism: Compute RSI via selectable variants (Basic, RSX, Cuttler, Ehlers, Harris, Quick, Gradual) on smoothed multi-source prices; color index flips on Hue_OnBoundaryCrossing, Hue_OnCenterCrossing, or Hue_OnDirectionShift; alerts fire on hue change.
data_needed: OHLC (or derived mid/standard/balanced/smoothed prices); RsiLength; ChosenRsiVariant; HueAdjustmentOn.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Chart symbol; multi-TF via iCustom on chosenTimeframe.
why_new_for_mis: Family of RSI-like transforms plus discrete hue-state transitions as an explicit momentum regime-change event stream for MIS, not a single static line.
quote: Hue shifts will change the indicator's color based on conditions like direction changes, center crossings, or boundary crossings, providing visual cues for trend reversals or strength.

mechanism: When AnalysisTimeframe > chart period, pull higher-TF RSI buffers via iCustom and linearly interpolate values across intervening lower-TF bars between higher-TF stamp changes (SMOOTH_MULTI_FRAME).
data_needed: Higher-TF indicator handle; chart timestamps; FRAME_RATIO = PeriodSeconds(HTF)/PeriodSeconds(LTF).
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol; HTF from M1–MN1 enum vs current chart.
why_new_for_mis: HTF momentum state projected onto LTF timeline without step artifacts—MIS multi-scale RSI sensing with explicit temporal alignment.
quote: multi-timeframe support will allow analysis across different periods with optional interpolation for smoother visuals.

mechanism: Quantize prices to ticksPerTpoLetter×Point grid; each eligible bar stamps a TPO letter across [qLow,qHigh]; POC = max tpoCount level; expand VA from POC by greedily adding adjacent levels until valueAreaPercent of total TPOs covered.
data_needed: OHLC session bars; ticksPerTpoLetter; valueAreaPercent; session TF (intraday/daily/weekly/monthly/fixed) + timezone/dailySessionRange.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any MT5 symbol; sessions e.g. daily 0830–1500, intraday N-minute profiles, fixed datetime range.
why_new_for_mis: Session auction map with time-at-price POC/VA—MIS liquidity/fair-value regime from distribution of time spent, not just OHLC extremes.
quote: calculates the point of control and value area from TPO counts, and provides visual rendering on the chart with customizable colors for detailed session analysis.

mechanism: Levels with tpoCount==1 colored as single prints (isolated time prints) versus denser VA/POC stacks—flags thin participation / potential imbalance zones in the session profile.
data_needed: Per-level tpoCount from session profile; singlePrintColor styling.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit thin-liquidity / single-print sensor inside session structure—MIS can mark poorly auctioned prices as breakout or revisit candidates.
quote: denser TPO stacks indicate balanced trading and thinner ones suggest potential breakouts or imbalances.

mechanism: Accumulate volume per price level (evenly split across quantized bar range, or from lower-TF tick volume); Volume Profile POC = max volume level; optional use VP POC as VA seed; session VWAP = Σ(price×volume)/Σvolume; highlight VP POC and VWAP separately from TPO POC.
data_needed: Tick volume; price grid; highlightVolumeProfilePoc / useVolumeProfilePocForValueArea / highlightSessionVwap flags.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any symbol; lower TF M1/M3/M10/H1 chosen from chart PeriodSeconds for volume rebuild.
why_new_for_mis: Dual POC (time vs volume) plus session VWAP—MIS can sense when fair-value by time disagrees with fair-value by participation.
quote: incorporating trading volume at each price level, allowing for the identification of volume-based point of control where the highest volume occurred, and adjusting value areas to reflect actual market participation rather than just time spent.

mechanism: Over first initialBalancePeriods of a session, track IB high/low; render IB edges and border segments; optional extensions of VP POC, VAH/VAL, session high/low, and midpoint (HIGH_LOW_MID or TPO_COUNT_BASED) forward as structure references.
data_needed: Per-period H/L/O arrays; initialBalancePeriods; showExtensionLines; midpointAlgorithm.
why_new_for_mis: Opening-range Initial Balance as an early-session regime bracket with extendable key levels—MIS structure sensor for breakout vs rotation relative to IB.
quote: detect initial balance from early periods, add extension rendering for key levels like highs, lows, value area boundaries, and midpoint

mechanism: Tick volume attributed ask/bid by close vs prior close (or last trade side if flat); bar delta = totalUp−totalDown; up/down % of total; boxColor from |delta|/total via GetVolumeColor; text intensity from how far winning % exceeds 50.
data_needed: Tick volume stream; close path; BarFootprintData totals; CalculateBarColorsAndPercentages each tick.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Any chart symbol/period with tick_volume (order-flow footprint).
why_new_for_mis: Bar-level aggression summary (delta, participation %, intensity)—MIS order-flow sentiment sensor aggregating footprint without reading every price row.
quote: Net delta shows which side was more aggressive in aggregate, total volume shows whether that aggression happened on meaningful participation or thin activity, and the buy and sell split reveals the degree of imbalance.

mechanism: Compare bar close direction to net delta sign; strong negative delta on higher close (or reverse) flags absorption/divergence; require high total volume before treating large delta as conviction; color heatmap across bars for momentum build vs sudden flip.
data_needed: Per-bar delta, total volume, up/down %; price direction of same bar.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Footprint chart bars on attached symbol/TF.
why_new_for_mis: Explicit delta-versus-price conflict plus volume-backed conviction gate—MIS change/early-reversal sensor from order-flow imbalance vs candle direction.
quote: a bar closing higher with a strongly negative delta is a warning that sellers were absorbing the move... Watch for consecutive bars where the delta direction conflicts with the price direction, as persistent delta divergence often precedes reversals.

mechanism: Per bar, POC = price level with max (up+down) volume; expand VA from POC by adding the richer adjacent level until valueAreaPercent of bar total volume is covered; render VA fill and dashed POC line.
why_new_for_mis: Intra-bar volume auction POC/VA—MIS micro-structure fair-value inside each candle, complementary to session TPO profiles.
quote: The level with the highest combined volume is the point of control... The value area is the price range around the point of control that contains a configurable share of the bar's volume, typically seventy percent.

mechanism: Diagonal ask imbalance: ask[i]/bid[i+1] ≥ imbalanceRatioThreshold for ≥ stackedImbalanceLevels consecutive rows (and symmetric bid); absorption if |delta|/total ≤ absorptionDeltaRatio on high-volume bar; single print if level volume ≤5% of bar max; unfinished business if extreme level has zero bid or ask.
data_needed: Per-level up/down volumes; imbalanceRatioThreshold; stackedImbalanceLevels; absorptionDeltaRatio.
instruments_and_timeframes_in_article: Order-flow footprint on any symbol/TF with ticks.
why_new_for_mis: Stacked aggression streaks plus absorption/single-print/unfinished-business classifiers—MIS layered order-flow change and liquidity-hole sensors inside the bar.
quote: Absorption is the opposite condition — a bar with high total volume but a net delta close to zero, meaning that one side absorbed the aggression of the other without allowing the price to move, often preceding a reversal.

mechanism: runningCVD accumulates each bar’s net delta into cumulativeDelta; CVD panel plots the running series with zero line and sign-colored segments; delta histogram scales each bar’s |delta| to maxAbsDelta as bottom-of-chart bars.
data_needed: Per-bar delta; runningCVD global; visible-bar CVD arrays.
why_new_for_mis: Path of cumulative aggression vs price as a sustained buy/sell-pressure regime, with per-bar delta histogram for local imbalance—MIS order-flow regime and divergence substrate.
quote: The cumulative volume delta tracks the running sum of net delta across all bars, revealing whether buying or selling pressure is building or fading over time, while the delta histogram provides a per-bar visual of that net imbalance
